C0684.title: Female Exam Candidate Bulk-Booked Hotels Near Test Centers and Resold Rooms at Markup
C0684.summary: In March 2026, a female candidate preparing for a public institution recruitment exam in Bijie, Guizhou, pre-booked hotel rooms in bulk near multiple test centers and planned to resell them to other candidates at inflated prices.
